steps.en: Officer sees offence rule codes with description and amount per vehicle type
steps.id: Officer melihat rule code pelanggaran dengan deskripsi dan nominal per tipe kendaraan

steps.en: Officer adds a rule code with description and amount for a vehicle type
steps.id: Officer menambah rule code dengan deskripsi dan nominal untuk satu tipe kendaraan

steps.en: Officer edits the description of an existing rule code
steps.id: Officer mengubah deskripsi rule code yang sudah ada

steps.en: Officer changes the composition amount of an existing rule code
steps.id: Officer mengubah nominal composition amount rule code yang ada
steps.why_en: The amount cannot be edited in place; officers must add a new dated row and close the old one.
steps.why_id: Nominal tidak bisa diubah langsung; officer harus menambah baris baru bertanggal dan menutup baris lama.

steps.en: Staff notice screens offer the configured amount for the chosen rule and vehicle
steps.id: Layar notice staff menawarkan nominal yang dikonfigurasi untuk rule dan kendaraan terpilih

steps.en: New notices carry the configured rule number and offence description
steps.id: Notice baru membawa nomor rule dan deskripsi pelanggaran yang dikonfigurasi

steps.en: Automatically created notices use the configured composition amount
steps.id: Notice yang dibuat otomatis memakai composition amount yang dikonfigurasi
steps.why_en: Automatic notices take the amount sent by the external system, not the configured one.
steps.why_id: Notice otomatis memakai nominal kiriman sistem eksternal, bukan yang dikonfigurasi.
